_about: Office reel v3 (AI avatar from marketing/avatar/reference/character_sheet.jpg). avatar_video.py makes a 9:16 first frame per shot with Gemini image (keyframes) and animates it with Veo (clips). Timings follow scripts/marketing/voiceover_reel.json; s1 and s5 are spoken to camera by Veo, the rest carries the v2 voice-over.
person: The man in the reference photos: Middle Eastern, early 30s, short thick wavy black hair, light stubble beard, brown eyes, slim build, wearing the same oatmeal-beige crew-neck knit sweater and dark blue jeans. Keep his face, hair, beard and clothes exactly as in the references.
room: a bright, modern private therapy practice: warm oak desk with a closed laptop and a notebook, a soft grey two-seat couch with a cushion, a tall green plant, a round wall clock, a large window with soft daylight and sheer curtains, one framed abstract print, clean calm interior
look: Photorealistic, shot on a full-frame cinema camera, 35mm lens, natural window light, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, true-to-life skin texture. Vertical 9:16 frame with the person in the middle third, headroom above, no text anywhere.
negative: text, captions, subtitles, letters, logos, watermark, cartoon, illustration, CGI look, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed face, different person, face morphing, readable phone screen, music

shots.frame: Medium shot. He sits behind the oak desk facing the camera, forearms resting on the desk, looking slightly down at his notebook, thoughtful. The empty grey couch is softly blurred behind him.
shots.motion: He looks up from the notebook straight into the camera and speaks the whole line to the viewer, honest and a little tired, natural blinking and small head movements, and finishes the sentence fully before the clip ends. Static camera, slow subtle push-in.
shots.speech: بِدْفَع أَجار عيادتي كامل… وهيّي فاضية نُصّ لِنهار.
shots.voice: a calm, deep, warm male voice, honest and a little tired, a small sigh before 'فاضية'

shots.frame: Medium-wide side angle. He sits at the oak desk in profile, turned toward the empty grey couch across the room; the round wall clock is visible on the wall.
shots.motion: He glances at the empty couch, then up at the wall clock, exhales, pushes his chair back and stands up from the desk. Slow camera push-in. No speaking.

shots.frame: Medium shot. He stands at a small side counter in the same office with a compact espresso machine and two white cups, three-quarter view, relaxed, the grey couch and the plant behind him, the room door closed.
shots.motion: He presses the button of the espresso machine, coffee pours into the white cup, he picks it up, takes a calm sip and gives a small satisfied smile, relaxed and in control of his time. His lips stay closed, he is not talking. Smooth slow handheld push-in.

shots.frame: Medium shot. He leans back against the front edge of the oak desk, holding a black smartphone in one hand at chest height, the screen facing him and away from the camera, looking down at it.
shots.motion: A message arrives; he reads it, smiles, and types a quick reply with his thumb, relaxed and pleased. Gentle slow dolly sideways. No speaking. Phone screen never visible.

shots.frame: Medium shot from the waist up. He stands in the middle of the office facing the camera, relaxed, friendly half-smile, the oak desk and the plant softly blurred behind him.
shots.motion: Confident, warm advertiser energy. He looks straight into the camera as if talking to one friend and says the whole line naturally: eyebrows lift, he leans in slightly, opens his palm toward the viewer on 'نزّل التطبيق', a confident smile on 'مجّاني'. Natural blinking and head movement. Static camera, slow subtle push-in.
shots.speech: إذا بدّك مكتب، نزّل التطبيق، تفتّش وتحجز كِلّو مجّاني.
shots.voice: a warm, confident, deep male voice with a clear BEIRUT accent (not Jordanian, not Syrian, not Egyptian): 'بدّك' said 'baddak', 'كِلّو' said 'kello', 'مجّاني' said 'majjēne' with the Beirut imala, soft Lebanese melody, smiling

shots.frame: Medium close-up from the chest up. He stands in the same office facing the camera, warm and energetic, the oak desk and the plant softly blurred behind him.
shots.motion: Call to action with real advertiser energy, WITHOUT talking: a narrator speaks over this shot, so his lips stay closed the whole time (a closed-mouth smile at most). He looks into the camera with a knowing, warm look, raises his eyebrows, points down toward the bottom of the screen twice as if to say 'comment below', nods, then breaks into a big genuine closed-mouth smile and an open-hand 'your turn' gesture toward the viewer. Natural blinking, small head movements. Slow push-in.
